calculation_type: Descriptive arithmetic and accounting identity; no causal identification or forecast

accounting_decomposition.interpretation: The terms allocate the observed change algebraically. They do not identify market conditions, product availability, pricing or Digiroom as causes; order of decomposition matters.

national_comparison.interpretation: Cross-scope new-sales comparison only. Not Auto2000 adoption, owner installed base or customer intent. Rounded national figure and channel consistency limit precision.

non_identification: xEV sales decline does not identify Digiroom causality.
New sales are flows, not the service-eligible installed base.
Dealer profit cannot be inferred from group/brand sales counts.
Reported digital infrastructure does not establish customer or advisor adoption.
